question: How were the Israelites to treat a servant they set free, and why?
options: Send them away empty; because they were poor
Charge them a fee; because of the law
Keep their belongings; because they had served
Supply them generously from their flock and produce; because Israel had been slaves in Egypt
explanation: A freed servant was not to be sent away empty-handed but supplied liberally from the flock, threshing floor, and winepress, because Israel remembered they had been slaves in Egypt and the Lord redeemed them.
